name: taptalk
description: TapTalk: privacy-first, local-first macOS dictation app with local faster-whisper and optional bring-your-own cloud STT providers

scripts.test: npm run check:architecture && npm run build && node scripts/run-node-tests.mjs
scripts.verify:release: npm test && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm pack --dry-run --json
scripts.dev: npm run build && TAPTALK_DEV_RELOAD=1 electron dist/electron/main.js
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:native
scripts.build:native: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('dist/native', { recursive: true })" && (test "$(uname)" != "Darwin" || swiftc -O scripts/native/PasteHelper.swift -o dist/native/PasteHelper) && (test "$(uname)" != "Darwin" || bash scripts/native/build-whisper-cpp.sh)
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir --publish never
